plugins/sncbnmbs/plugin_info/configurati.Secondes avant d'abandonner un appel à i: Seconds before giving up on an iRail call. The journey is read again every minute while monitoring: beyond 8 seconds, a slow service would delay the whole box's cron for a timetable that will be fetched again a minute later anyway.
plugins/sncbnmbs/plugin_info/configurati.Langue dans laquelle iRail rend le nom d: Language in which iRail returns station names, directions and disruptions. Empty follows the Jeedom language, which is almost always right; forcing it helps on a Flemish journey announced in Dutch on the platforms.

plugins/sncbnmbs/desktop/php/sncbnmbs.ph.Aucun trajet pour le moment. Pour démarr: No journey yet. To get started:
plugins/sncbnmbs/desktop/php/sncbnmbs.ph.Cliquez sur « Ajouter un trajet » et don: Click “Add a journey” and give it a name, for example “Morning outbound”.
plugins/sncbnmbs/desktop/php/sncbnmbs.ph.Tapez les premières lettres de la gare d: Type the first letters of the departure station, then choose it from the list. Do the same for the arrival station.
Type the first letters of the departure station, then choose it from the list. Do the same for the arrival station.
plugins/sncbnmbs/desktop/php/sncbnmbs.ph.Réglez le créneau : les heures entre les: Set the time window: the hours between which you usually take the train, and the days concerned.
plugins/sncbnmbs/desktop/php/sncbnmbs.ph.Enregistrez : les commandes sont créées: Save: the commands are created and the day's timetable is fetched.
plugins/sncbnmbs/desktop/php/sncbnmbs.ph.Deux caractères au minimum. « bruxelles: Two characters minimum. “bruxelles midi” finds “Bruxelles-Midi”: accents and hyphens are ignored.
plugins/sncbnmbs/desktop/php/sncbnmbs.ph.Le trajet n'est exploitable que si les d: The journey only works if the two stations differ: a station to itself makes the request time out without ever returning a timetable.
plugins/sncbnmbs/desktop/php/sncbnmbs.ph.Échange départ et arrivée. Dupliquez le: Swaps departure and arrival. Duplicate the morning journey, reverse it and shift its time window: you have the evening return without retyping the stations.
plugins/sncbnmbs/desktop/php/sncbnmbs.ph.Seuls les trains partant entre ces deux: Only trains departing between these two times are tracked. An end earlier than the start describes an overnight time window, which finishes the next morning.
plugins/sncbnmbs/desktop/php/sncbnmbs.ph.Les jours où vous faites ce trajet. Aucu: The days on which you make this journey. No box ticked means every day: a commuter will tick Monday to Friday so the plugin stops querying the network at the weekend.
plugins/sncbnmbs/desktop/php/sncbnmbs.ph.À partir de ce retard, le train est décl: From this delay onwards, the train is declared late and the alert is sent. Too low, and SNCB's daily two minutes wake you for nothing.
plugins/sncbnmbs/desktop/php/sncbnmbs.ph.Cochée, le trajet est relu chaque minute: Ticked, the journey is read again every minute during the time window: a delay is known almost at once. Unticked, it is only read again every quarter of an hour; alerts are still sent, but up to fifteen minutes late.
plugins/sncbnmbs/desktop/php/sncbnmbs.ph.Combien de temps avant le début du créne: How long before the start of the time window minute-by-minute monitoring starts. Allow plenty: being warned at home still lets you catch the earlier train.
plugins/sncbnmbs/desktop/php/sncbnmbs.ph.Commande d'action exécutée dès qu'un pro: Action command run as soon as a problem appears on the journey: a spoken message, a notification. The alert text is passed to it as a parameter.
plugins/sncbnmbs/desktop/php/sncbnmbs.ph.Interroge le réseau immédiatement. Inuti: Queries the network immediately. Pointless just after a save, which already does it.
plugins/sncbnmbs/desktop/php/sncbnmbs.ph.Fait taire l'alerte en cours jusqu'au pr: Silences the current alert until the situation next changes.
plugins/sncbnmbs/desktop/php/sncbnmbs.ph.Les trains du jour et du lendemain reten: The trains for today and tomorrow selected for this journey, as the network announces them. This tab reads what the plugin has already fetched: opening it does not query the network.
plugins/sncbnmbs/desktop/php/sncbnmbs.ph.Les perturbations que la SNCB publie pou: The disruptions SNCB publishes for the whole network, journey or not. Those naming one of your two stations are repeated in the “Trains” tab.
plugins/sncbnmbs/desktop/php/sncbnmbs.ph.Nombre de départs demandés par créneau,: How many departures are requested per window, 6 at most: beyond that, iRail silently ignores the request and returns six anyway. Past the length of your window, the extra trains no longer concern you in any case.
